title: Kidney and Urinary Pathway Knowledge Base

description.en: The KUPKB is a collection of omics datasets that have been extracted from scientific publications and other related renal databases. The iKUP browser provides a single point of entry for you to query and browse these datasets. http://www.kupkb.org. SPARQL endpoint http://sparql.kupkb.org/sparql
